name: Boxing Hand Wraps GEL Legion Octagon Advance Tech Gel black
descHtml:
Legion Octagon gel boxing wraps are made of high-quality cotton, polyester, and elastane. The high-quality composition of the wraps provides effective support and protection for the wrists, preventing them from deforming after washing.

The advanced formula of Advance Tech Gel effectively absorbs blows and protects the knuckles.

Legion Octagon boxing wraps are the first line of hand protection, stiffening and stabilizing the wrist, minimizing the risk of injury. They also protect boxing gloves/MMA gloves from absorbing sweat, extending their lifespan.

Legion Octagon boxing wraps do not restrict freedom of movement, and the soft, sweat-absorbing fabric additionally protects the hand from abrasion.

Ideal for boxing and other combat sports.

PRODUCT SPECIFICATIONS:

Composition: 70% polyester, 28% cotton, 2% elastane

WARNING!
No wrap provides complete protection against injury.

name: Head Guard Legion Octagon Guardox dark blue 2w1
descHtml:
Legion Octagon Guardox Dark Blue Sparring Helmet with Face Mask

The Legion Octagon Guardox Dark Blue is a professional sparring helmet with a full face shield, designed for fighters who require maximum protection during intense training sessions. The enclosed design effectively protects the forehead, cheeks, nose, chin, and ears, minimizing the risk of injuries and contusions during sparring.

A special front mask protects the central part of the face without significantly restricting the field of vision. Thanks to its ergonomic design, the helmet fits snugly to the head, ensuring stability and high comfort even during dynamic exchanges.

Multi-layer cushioning foam effectively absorbs impacts, while durable materials and a robust finish ensure durability against intensive use. The matte black finish gives the model a modern and professional look. Key Features:

Full face and head protection
Enclosed nose and chin protection
Wide field of vision
Thick impact-absorbing foam
Stable and comfortable fit
Ear and back of head protection
Durable construction for intense sparring
Minimalist blue matte design

name: Women's Legion Octagon Ribber Beige Leggings
descHtml:
Designed to move with you, the Octagon Ribbed Leggings combine premium comfort with a sleek, sculpting silhouette. Crafted from a high-performance ribbed fabric, they offer the perfect balance of softness, stretch, and support, making them an essential piece for both training sessions and everyday wear.

The high-rise waistband provides a secure, flattering fit that gently contours the waist while staying comfortably in place through every movement. The ribbed texture enhances the premium aesthetic, creating a clean, minimal look that transitions effortlessly from the gym to your everyday wardrobe.

Made from a durable blend of 74% polyester and 26% spandex, these leggings deliver exceptional flexibility, shape retention, and all-day comfort. Minimal branding and refined detailing reflect Octagon's commitment to quality, functionality, and modern style.

  • 4-way stretch for unrestricted movement
  • Supportive wide waistband that stays in place
  • Excellent shape retention and lasting comfort
  • Breathable and lightweight construction
  • Perfect for training, yoga, fitness, and everyday wear
  • Minimalist Octagon branding

74% Polyester, 26% Spandex

name: ODZIEŻ Z WŁASNYM NADRUKIEM NA JAKOŚCI OCTAGON
descHtml:
Our production department is one of the main pillars of our business. We are characterized by quality and attractive pricing. We carry out custom projects for companies in every industry, sports clubs, fan clubs, and many others.

All stages of production are in-house. We have our own printing house, cutting room, and extensive machinery, and all products are made from scratch in our Polish sewing facility 🇵🇱
We offer a variety of materials, colors, and sizes, as well as various types of decoration.

DTG digital printing - one of the most modern clothing printing methods. A full color palette, color depth, and high detail reproduction with near-photographic accuracy. Used primarily on cotton products (T-shirts, polo shirts, sweatshirts, and pants).

Screen printing with HD elements - one of the most durable clothing decoration methods, resistant to damage, moisture, UV radiation, and washing. Used primarily on cotton products (T-shirts, polo shirts, sweatshirts, pants).

Sublimation printing - Particularly popular on sportswear, which requires high quality and durability. Resistant to both washing and abrasion, it allows for vibrant colors and sharp print contours, with all shades and tonal transitions rendered with extraordinary precision. Used primarily on sportswear (T-shirts, rash guards, leggings, shorts, tops).

Computer embroidery - a clothing decoration method that involves simply embroidering a design onto fabric using a machine. This is undoubtedly a very durable method of branding clothing and textiles.

Our team includes a qualified team of graphic designers who can create designs that will attract attention and distinguish your company/club from the competition.

Our goal is to provide the highest quality services.

We are open to any collaboration.

If you'd like to create clothing with your own print, please contact us.

We'll design and sew it!

name: Legion Octagon Eclipse Boxing Gloves black/black
descHtml:
Legion Octagon Eclipse Boxing Gloves

The Legion Octagon Eclipse boxing gloves are designed for athletes who expect the perfect combination of modern design, comfort, and durability. Featuring a distinctive OCTAGON-inspired pattern, these gloves stand out with a bold, dynamic look. They are an excellent choice for heavy bag training, pad work, and sparring sessions.

Made from high-quality synthetic leather, the gloves offer excellent resistance to abrasion and wear, maintaining their appearance even during intensive training. Their ergonomic design and anatomically shaped construction promote a natural hand position, while the durable hook-and-loop wrist closure provides secure wrist support and enhanced protection during every workout.

The Legion Octagon Eclipse gloves are engineered with user comfort in mind. The multi-layer foam padding effectively absorbs impact, helping protect your hands and knuckles, while the premium construction ensures long-lasting performance.

Key Features

  • Made from high-quality synthetic leather

  • Modern Eclipse design

  • Multi-layer foam padding for superior shock absorption

  • Ergonomic shape for a natural hand position

  • Wide, durable hook-and-loop wrist strap for excellent wrist support

  • High resistance to abrasion and intensive use

  • Ideal for boxing, kickboxing, and other striking sports

The Legion Octagon Eclipse boxing gloves are the perfect choice for athletes who want to train with confidence while enjoying premium craftsmanship, reliable protection, and a distinctive style.

name: Cotton Tank Top Legion Octagon Small Logo beige
descHtml:
Men's 100% Cotton Tank Top – Classic Everyday Comfort

Minimalist design, natural cotton, and a comfortable fit – this tank top was created for men who value comfort and timeless style. Made of 100% high-quality cotton, it is soft, pleasant to the touch, and provides all-day comfort.

The classic racerback design allows for complete freedom of movement and highlights a sporty silhouette. This tank top is perfect for both moderate-intensity workouts and everyday wear – on warm days, for a walk, or as part of a casual outfit.

The black color scheme and subtle logo on the front and back give it a modern, versatile feel, making it easy to pair with shorts, joggers, or jeans. Key features:

Made of 100% cotton,

Made entirely in Poland 🇵🇱
Soft and pleasant-to-touch material,
Breathable, natural fabric for comfort,
Classic racerback cut,
Minimalist design with logo on the chest and back,
Perfect for everyday wear, recreational training, and summer days.

Material: 100% cotton
Color: Black
Cut: Regular Fit
